title: QC native broker JSON-RPC v1
description: Local host IPC for the canonical gateway plus three host-internal methods (device.status, device.state.events, device.state.blockDetails). Frames are four-byte big-endian length followed by UTF-8 JSON. The host-internal methods must never be exposed through MCP or a remote relay. The legacy device.raw.* and device.command.* methods were removed and answer Method not found. This document validates broker requests (see $defs/request); host-specific response extensions are outside this core contract.

internalCompatibilityRequest.description: Host-process compatibility API. This is not a public, relayable, or MCP tool surface.

request.description: The native broker's request envelope. Compatibility requests are fully modeled by internalCompatibilityRequest above; the broker also forwards the gateway's JSON-RPC request envelope (jsonrpc/id/method/params); host-specific response extensions are outside this core contract.
